parameters.name: MACAddress
parameters.description: The physical address of this node.

parameters.name: NodeID
parameters.description: The Node ID of this node.

parameters.name: IsMaster
parameters.description: Whether this node is the HPNA network master.

parameters.name: Synced
parameters.description: Whether this node is synchronized with the HPNA network master. If this node is the HPNA network master, {{param}} MUST be {{true}}.

parameters.name: TotalSyncTime
parameters.description: Total time in {{units}} (since device reset) that this node has been up and synchronized to the HPNA network master.

parameters.name: MaxBitRate
parameters.description: This node's maximum HPNA PHY bit rate (expressed in {{units}}).

parameters.name: PHYDiagnosticsEnable
parameters.description: Enable / disable PHY throughput diagnostics mode on this node. All devices that are enabled will participate in the HPNA network PHY throughput diagnostics process.

parameters.name: Active
parameters.description: Whether or not this node is currently present in the HPNA network. The ability to list inactive nodes is OPTIONAL. If the CPE includes inactive nodes in this table, {{param}} MUST be set to {{false}} for each inactive node. The length of time an inactive node remains listed in this table is a local matter to the CPE.

object.description: This table provides information about other HPNA devices that are directly accessible via this HPNA interface.
